metadata.description: OmniResearch - A suite of 9 AI agent skills for accelerating scientific innovation. Provides evidence-bound, traceable research workflow with contract system, dependency resolution, and skill tree progression. Supports 5 research patterns: Evidence-First, Idea-First, Decision-First, Experiment-First, and Rapid-Prototype.

skills.name: omr-core
skills.description: Foundation infrastructure for OmniResearch skills system. Provides contract system, dependency resolver, skill tree tracking, and pattern definitions. MUST install this before any other omr-* skills. Use when setting up OmniResearch environment or when skills report missing infrastructure dependencies.

skills.name: omr-bootstrap
skills.description: Initialize new OmniResearch project workspace. Creates complete directory structure (materials/, docs/, src/, wiki/), generates AGENTS.md with research context, and displays skill tree showing available next actions. Use whenever starting a new research project. REQUIRES omr-core skill for infrastructure setup.

skills.name: omr-collection
skills.description: Material collection with passive reception philosophy. User provides sources, skill delivers materials. Supports direct input (URLs, DOIs, paths) and search queries. 4 handlers (Generic Web, Paper, GitHub, HuggingFace) with minimal parsing and balanced error handling. Use for collecting research materials, downloading papers, gathering repos. REQUIRES omr-core and workspace initialization.

skills.name: omr-analyze
skills.description: Analyze collected materials and plan research execution. Scans raw materials, extracts findings with strict evidence boundaries (proven, suggests, inferred), generates research brief and evidence map, synthesizes judgment with confidence assessment, and creates a prioritized research plan. Enforces Gate A review as an internal checkpoint before execution. Merged from omr-evidence + omr-research-plan. Use when ready to analyze collected papers and materials. REQUIRES omr-core skill and workspace with collected materials.

skills.name: omr-decision
skills.description: Create architectural decisions with alternatives, rationale, and evidence references. Documents at least 3 alternatives, selects best option based on evidence, identifies risks, ensures traceability. Enforces Gate B review checking alternatives and risks documented. Use when making architecture choices. REQUIRES omr-core and workspace with research plan.

skills.name: omr-evaluation
skills.description: Design and run evaluation experiments to validate architecture decisions. Creates experiment specification with hypothesis, metrics, ground truth strategy. Implements prototype code and evaluation tests. Enforces Gate C review checking metrics and reproducibility. Use for testing and validation. REQUIRES omr-core and workspace with decisions.

skills.name: omr-synthesis
skills.description: Write authoritative research findings in configurable formats (survey chapters, industry reports, academic manuscripts, executive briefs). Ensures traceability linking every claim to evidence. Enforces strict evidence boundaries and Gate D review. After Gate D passes, auto-generates living wiki (interlinked concept pages). Use --no-wiki to skip wiki generation. Merged from omr-synthesis + omr-wiki. Use for documenting final results. REQUIRES omr-core and workspace with completed research.

skills.name: omr-idea-note
skills.description: Capture speculative thoughts and creative insights outside formal research pipeline. Creates timestamped idea notes that can be linked to decisions and experiments later. Available anytime during research process. Supports Idea-First research pattern. Use for capturing hypotheses and insights. REQUIRES omr-core and workspace initialization.

skills.name: omr-reconcile
skills.description: Update research state when new evidence contradicts existing artifacts. Analyzes impact blast radius, proposes reconciliation options, archives old versions, and updates downstream artifacts while maintaining traceability. Also provides manual snapshot/rollback capability (--archive, --rollback, --list, --review flags). Merged from omr-reconcile + omr-research-archive. Use when handling contradictions or archiving state. REQUIRES omr-core and workspace with existing artifacts.
